statement: After completing an invertible indefinite original-coordinate physical pair B, if an original-coordinate principal bank of the exact Schur complement has rank two with pseudo-determinant Pi_2, then for arbitrary independent cap-one laws the output has an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= min{512 kappa^(-1/2) Pi_2^(-1/4), 64(|det B| kappa)^(-1/4) Pi_2^(-1/8)}. No sign restriction on the rank-two Schur bank and no restriction on the conditioning-induced affine vector, including its kernel component. Absolute continuity is proved; continuity is not proved in this full scope.

partner_results_applied.application: For A_c=diag(1,-1) direct_sum [[0,c],[c,0]], combine partner bound 22.385(2c^2)^(-1/12) with new 64|c|^(-1/4) and 512|c|^(-1/2) branches.
Exact signed-Fejer identity transfers the new essential-density bound to sup_(T,y) D_T law(Q)(y); grouped-square density cap is also applied to a dependent-shift target-valid control.
